verdict.rationale: An OS could plausibly ship a natural-language assistant, so this axis applies, but nothing in the pack documents one for Ubuntu Desktop. The legacy Unity HUD let users type to find menu items, which is keyword menu search in a discontinued shell, not natural-language operation. AT-SPI interfaces are developer building blocks, and the command line is not natural-language input, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
